Non-custodial Wallet. Pera Wallet is a non-custodial wallet (or "self-hosted" wallet) software designed for managing digital assets, including cryptocurrencies and NFTs ("Digital Assets"). As a non-custodial wallet, Pera Wallet gives you full control over and responsibility for your Digital Assets and private keys, allowing you to authorize transactions from your wallet address. As a self-hosted wallet: (i) the Digital Asset remains in the possession of the wallet owner on his or her own device; (ii) the wallet owner interacts with the payment system directly; (iii) the wallet owner has total, independent control over the Digital Asset; and (iv) the wallet owner generates their own cryptographic keys, which are stored on their local device. This non-custodial wallet operates in an unregulated environment, and as such, it does not benefit from the same regulatory oversight as regulated crypto or traditional financial institutions. Users are solely responsible for the security of their private keys and the safekeeping of their funds. Please be aware of the inherent risks associated with cryptocurrencies, including market volatility and the absence of certain consumer protections. This wallet is committed to legal compliance within applicable frameworks, but users should carefully consider their risk tolerance and conduct their own research before using our services. By using Pera Wallet, you acknowledge and agree that you bear sole responsibility for your activities and assume any associated risk of loss.

Services. With Pera Wallet, you can ("Services"):

  • Generate Wallets: Create wallet addresses and associated private keys to securely send and receive digital assets.
  • Access dApps: Use the mobile app's and web browser to browse and interact with third-party decentralized applications ("dApps") and decentralized exchanges ("DEX").
  • Buy, Sell, and Swap: Trade or swap digital assets using the DApp and onramp features provided by third-party services.
  • Stake: Stake eligible digital assets through third-party dApps and websites in the Algorand ecosystem. To participate in staking, you must accept the Pera Wallet Staking Service Disclaimers.
  • Governance and voting: Algorand Protocol may offer stakers voting rights concerning matters of protocol-level governance. Pera reserves the right at its discretion to either support or discontinue voting for these particular assets. Pera bears NO responsibility, legal or otherwise, for any voting decisions or actions taken by the user or the Validators on behalf of the users (stakers).
  • Explore: Access digital asset price information provided by third-party providers.

We do not recommend that any Algo or any Digital assets be bought, sold, swapped, staked, or held by you. We do not broker trades on your behalf. The content herein may provide access to or link to third-party services in connection with the buy/sell and swap functionalities. When accessing third-party services, you understand that you are not transferring your assets to us.

Risks. You accept and acknowledge and accept the various risks inherent to using a digital asset network, including but not limited to hardware failure, software issues, internet connection failure, malicious software, third party interference leading to access to your wallet and other user data, unknown vulnerabilities and unanticipated changes to the protocol. You accept and acknowledge that Pera will not be responsible for any communication failures, disruptions, errors, distortions or delays you may experience when using the Wallet, however caused and will not be responsible for any harm occurring as a result of such risks. Our Services are built on emerging technologies, such as the Algorand blockchain. Some of these Services carry additional risks, particularly if you misuse tools like public/private key cryptography or fail to properly update or manage software in response to protocol changes. By using Pera Wallet's Services, you acknowledge and accept these heightened risks. You affirm that you have the financial and technical expertise to understand the inherent risks of cryptographic and blockchain-based systems, and that you are knowledgeable in the use and complexities of digital assets, such as ALGO tokens. Specifically, you understand that we do not control or operate the Algorand protocol, execute protocol upgrades, or facilitate transactions on your behalf. You further recognize that blockchain protocols come with their own unique risks, and that your participation may result in losses if protocol rules are violated. You also understand that blockchain-based transactions are irreversible, and it is essential to keep your private key and secret recovery phrase secure at all times. Pera Wallet does NOT store or recover private keys or recovery phrases. Storing your recovery phrase digitally, such as on a cloud service or any third-party device, may increase the risk of loss or theft. You are solely responsible for any authorizations or permissions granted through cryptographic signatures on blockchain messages or transactions, especially those prompted by third parties. You acknowledge that social engineering scams, such as pig butchering schemes, present real risks, and you alone are responsible for any interactions with third parties that may result in harm. You agree that Pera Wallet is not liable for verifying the legitimacy, safety, or suitability of any third-party applications or tokens with which you may interact through our offerings.
